objective: build and calibrate original Figure6B same-task improvement evaluator; no candidate search or scientific improvement claim

calibration.split: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5,shuffle=True,random_state=622) on original source HW row order
calibration.features: all original X columns, rows y in {3,4}, clip[-5,5]; 40 bins/unit; processed whole-session transductive source
calibration.metric: pool each session complete OOF; balanced accuracy; equal arithmetic mean of40session scores
calibration.tolerance_rationale: Two-decimal percentage rounding half-unit:0.005 percentage points=0.00005. Applicable only if complete source panel and recipe equivalence authenticated; no version-drift allowance or post-hoc widening.
calibration.failure_policy: Record mismatch or failed source admission; no narrowing, tuning, retries of fits or tolerance change

source_access.permitted: identified public processed archive plus source metadata/code; public source labels evaluator-only for conversion and baseline
source_access.prohibited: earlier solver predictions, untouched private targets, other bulk archives

candidate_policy.fold_state: separate opaque train/query delivery and isolated per-fold execution using existing engine; no other fold state
candidate_policy.identity: random opaque candidate case and query IDs; no source names/indices/class block order

readiness.minimum_effect: unresolved; must justify from behavior/decision value before candidate final testing
readiness.uncertainty: requires authenticated rat-session map and predeclared rat-aware paired procedure; no invented independence
